Guide a fun comparison of all the finds. Observations collected: Find 1: soft; Find 2: wiggly; Find 3: fluffy.
Help the child see how the same thing (pattern) looks DIFFERENT on each item. 
Goal: Children see how pattern varies across all items. 
Then invite the child to give each find a fun creative name (e.g. 'Freckle Stone', 'Polka Petal'). Length: 6-10 sentences. End warmly — do NOT end with a question.
